performance.cable-capacity-basis: Cat6 24AWG (6.1 mm) cables at 100 % fill through the four D-rings, theoretical; 26 at the recommended 30 %. The two end rings are stated apart, 153 (46 at 30 %), for vertical runs - FS Horizontal Cable Managers with D-rings datasheet, Cable Capacity Reference Guide

physical.mounting-hardware: M6*15mm Screw x4 and M6Nut x4

configs.description: The cable manager as FS ships #64184, four D-rings and two end rings fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: the drawing of this part does not show the panel's folded edges; they are taken as the CMH-5DR1U-N's 12 mm, which the renders show this part shares.
gaps.wanted: a side view with the folds dimensioned, or a ruler on the part
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - style, panel and ring material, rack units and the mounting hardware are the D-rings datasheet's specification table.

cable-capacity.note: datasheet - 87 Cat6 24AWG 6.1 mm cables at 100 % fill, 26 at the recommended 30 %, for the D-rings, in the Cable Capacity Reference Guide of FS's D-rings datasheet. The same guide gives the end rings 153 and 46 on the same basis; they hold a vertical run, a different path from the horizontal one, and are not added to it.

chassis.note: drawing for 430 x 44, estimated for the 100. The plate is flat over the whole 19 in [482.6mm] and its top and bottom edges fold back over 16.9 in [430mm], 1.04 in [26.3mm] in from each end; the flat ends outside the folds are the ears, so the body is the 430. The front is drawn at the 482.6 rack face with the ears on it, because the ears carry the end rings (#865), as the R740xd's front carries its ports. The datasheet's 3.46 in (88 mm) depth is the ring's longer arm from the face of the plate. The renders (gallery image 2, the back) show the edges folded back, as on the CMH-5DR1U-N, but this part's drawing does not dimension them; they are taken as the CMH-5DR1U-N's 12, and the folded edge is that part's flange. The product page's 88 for the depth agrees with the datasheet's table.

color.note: estimated - "Steel, Powder-coated Black" and "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render.

ears.note: drawing - the ears are the plate's flat ends outside the folds, 26.3 wide, with an oval rack-screw slot near the top and the bottom of each, read off the front view (fs/cmh-6dr1u-ear@1). They are drawn because they carry the end rings.

end-rings.note: drawing - a steel loop bolted to the front of each ear, lying flat at mid-height with its strip 12 mm deep, so that cables run vertically through it beside the rack posts (fs/cmh-6dr1u-end-ring@1, whose contract has the plan). The front view puts each 86 mm span from 1.7 in [43mm] outside the end of the 482.6 to 43 mm inside it, which is 16.7 mm onto the plate past the fold, so the part is 568.6 mm across with both rings. They stand in the plane of the ears, like the D-rings in the panel's, and the right ring is the left one turned half round. Which side of the plan lies against the ear is not drawn, and is estimated in the ring's contract.

front.note: drawing - the front view: the plate between the folds and the four D-rings, centred 62 mm from the left fold and 102 apart: the drawing dimensions 1.04 in [26.3mm] plus 2.4 in [62mm] to the first ring's centre and 4 in [102mm] between centres, and the four read 102 mm apart, symmetric about the middle. Each ring is 12.4 wide on this drawing and 12.7 on the CMH-5DR1U-N one, the same ring; its contract has the rest. The face is the 482.6 rack face, the panel 26.3 in from each end and an ear either side of it, with the end rings bolted across the ears and reaching past them. FS's mark, printed on the left ear, is not drawn.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the rings stand 88 mm in front of the panel, and nothing but the panel's folded edges stands behind it, so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part (#854).

left.note: drawing - an elevation, the ring's profile in front of the plate and the folded edges behind it. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FIRST, FROM THE VENDOR'S OWN DIMENSIONED DRAWING. The part has no datasheet of its own, but FS's Horizontal Cable Managers with D-rings datasheet covers it: a column of its specification table, a row of its capacity guide, and a page of drawings - a side view of a D-ring, a plan of an end ring and a front view, dimensioned in inches with millimetres in brackets. The front view is 1.861 px/mm across from the 482.6 line (898 px) and 1.98 down from the 44 (87 px), a 6 % difference between the axes; the 430, 102, 62, 43 and 26.3 lines agree with the across scale to under a millimetre. Positions are read across and heights down. The product page's 13 renders were used for the ring's orientation and to confirm the folded edges.

mount.note: datasheet - the D-rings datasheet notes that the part cannot be used with a vertical cable manager in the same cabinet, and that the distance between the posts and the mounting rails should be more than 1.97 in: the end rings take that space.

overhang.note: drawing - 43 each side: the front view's 1.7 in [43mm] from the end of the 19 in [482.6mm] to the outer leg of each end ring (#865). The rings are placed at x -43 and 439.6 on the 482.6 face.

rear.note: photo-measured - the back of the plate, plain, as FS's render of the back (gallery image 2) shows it.

rings.note: drawing - the D-rings are the CMH-5DR1U-N's: the same 12.4 to 12.7 mm strip, the same 3 in [77mm] and 3.4 in [88mm] arms, and 1.7 in [42mm] high, which that part's ring reads 41.3. This part's side view draws the long arm on top, curling down; FS's renders (feature image 1, gallery image 5) show the short arm on top hooking down, as on the CMH-5DR1U-N, and the renders are taken.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.2 mm, the sheet FS dimensions on the CMH-4DRB1U drawing of the same datasheet. No view of this part dimensions its sheet.

top.note: drawing - an elevation: the folded edge behind the plate, and the four rings' upper arms from above to 77 mm, with the lower arms reaching on to 88. The bottom is the same from underneath, where the lower arms are seen whole.

weight.note: datasheet - 0.66 kg in the specification table of FS's product page for #64184. The D-rings datasheet states no weight for any of its four managers. The page is not a held document.
